arStrings.szText: Commanding your Blood Golem also causes it to drain Life from your other {c_important}Minions{/c}, increasing its Maximum Life by {c_number}[SF_2*100|%|]{/c} and damage by {c_number}[SF_3*100|x%|]{/c} per {c_important}Minion{/c} drained for {c_number}20{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}[{SF_2}*{SF_4}*100|%|]{/c} increased Maximum Life and {c_number}[{SF_3}*{SF_4}*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage.
